verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has its own event-triggered actions. Project alerts on new errors send email or call a webhook URL added as an alert recipient, and uptime monitors send email or webhook alerts when a ping fails. These are fixed alert types, not a user-defined rules engine. Missing for 10: configurable rule conditions (filters, thresholds, frequency), actions beyond notification such as auto-assign or auto-resolve, an API or programmatic way to define rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
